==Biography==
Shirou "'''Paz'''" Sasaki was born in Hokkaido, but moved to Yamaguchi, Tokushima, and Tokyo. He played baseball in junior high school, but quit because of an injury. Afterward, he began to play online games.

== Trivia ==
* His name comes from the spanish word "Paz" which means "Peace".
* He is fluent in Japanese, Korean and English.
* His favorite food are strawberries
